headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen with broad availability and agentic-workflow claims
summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 November 2026 and says it is rolling out across Gemini API, AI Studio, business products, the Gemini app and Search. Google positions it as a faster execution model for everyday coding and agentic workflows, offers a 1-million-token context window, and lists API prices of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Google reports an Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score of 51 at its default high thinking level (54 at xhigh), Terminal-Bench 4.1 score of 57% versus 18.2% for Gemini 3.8 Flash, and an Antigravity Orchestrator result near Gemini 4 Carbon task success while using 24% less quota and finishing 19% faster on Terminal-Bench 4.0. These are provider-reported figures, not independently reproduced in this review.
